_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Mercenary#000.src: Looks like the others have gone ahead. You should rendezvous with them closer to the barracks.
The Mercenary#000.dst: 다른 이들은 먼저 간 것 같다. 병영 근처에서 그들과 합류해야겠다.

The Mercenary#001.src: Dang, you're right. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#001.dst: 젠장, 네 말이 맞아. 역사적 가치를 잊으면 안 되지. 잘 짚었어.

The Mercenary#002.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I can count.
The Mercenary#002.dst: 병사들이 쓰러지고 또 쓰러지고 또 쓰러지고, 다시 일어나는 걸 봤다. 전장의 혼돈과 죽음을 셀 수 없이 겪었지.

The Mercenary#003.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more when compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#003.dst: 너희부터 시작하지. 수십 명에 비하면 둘쯤이야?

The Mercenary#004.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're goin' to be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#004.dst: 그러니 항복할게! 의미 없는 싸움을 할 이유가 없지. 어차피 이 난장판 뒤엔 돈도 못 받을 테고.

The Mercenary#008.src: Takan is dead. You should regroup with the others outside the barracks.
The Mercenary#008.dst: Takan은 죽었다. 병영 밖에서 다른 이들과 합류해야겠다.

The Mercenary#009.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a very dangerous man.
The Mercenary#009.dst: 결국 처치해서 다행이야. 그가 한 말들... 아주 위험한 사람 같았어.

The Mercenary#010.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan was saying, it was-
The Mercenary#010.dst: 제독님. Takan이 한 말 중에 일부는-

The Mercenary#011.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in that traitor's words. People like him... all they do is spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#011.dst: 그 반역자의 말은 너무 믿지 마라. 저런 놈들은... 근거 없는 독설만 퍼부으며, 우리가 지키는 질서에 맞서 대중을 선동할 뿐이지.

The Mercenary#012.src: He was an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#012.dst: 그는 상상 속 부당함에 원한을 품은 분노한 자였을 뿐이다. 그 이상은 없어. 잊어버리는 게 좋을 거다.

The Mercenary#013.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters through to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#013.dst: 그래도 대략적인 위치를 알면 도움이 돼. 편지를 전할 수 있나 알아볼게. 알려 줘서 고마워.

The Mercenary#014.src: Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.
The Mercenary#014.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p}에서 정찰병에게 말을 걸거나 다른 마을에서 정찰병을 찾으세요.

The Mercenary#016.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#016.dst: Almuji 군의 Amerigo 제독이 Wynn 지방 곳곳의 건장하고 소속 없는 병사들에게 도움을 청하고 있네.
The Mercenary#016.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#017.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#017.dst: 솔직히 말하면... 그쪽에 곤란한 일이 생겼어. {p}의 상비군이 포로로 잡혔고, 사막 병영도 점령당했지.
The Mercenary#017.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#018.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#018.dst: 제독이 정찰병들을 보내 자유로운 병사들을 모아... 이 사태를 수습하려 하네.
The Mercenary#018.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#019.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#019.dst: ... 내 생각엔 조용하고 은밀하게 처리하길 원하는 것 같아. 상황을 보면 그 양반을 탓할 수도 없지.
The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#020.dst: 아무튼 가능하면 그쪽으로 가 보게. {p}은(는) {p} 동쪽의 사막 도시야. 가 본 적 없다면 말이지.
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#021.dst: 그럼 난 이만! 찾을 병사가 아직 많거든. 소집에 응한다면 행운을 비네!
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#023.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#023.dst: Almuji 군의 Amerigo 제독이 Wynn 지방 곳곳의 건장하고 소속 없는 병사들에게 도움을 청하고 있네.

The Mercenary#026.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#027.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#028.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#030.dst: Almuji 군의 Amerigo 제독이 Wynn 지방 곳곳의 건장하고 소속 없는 병사들에게 도움을 청하고 있네.
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#031.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#031.dst: 솔직히 말하면... 그쪽에 곤란한 일이 생겼어. {p}의 상비군이 포로로 잡혔고, 사막 병영도 점령당했지.
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#032.dst: 제독이 정찰병들을 보내 자유로운 병사들을 모아... 이 사태를 수습하려 하네.
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#033.dst: ... 내 생각엔 조용하고 은밀하게 처리하길 원하는 것 같아. 상황을 보면 그 양반을 탓할 수도 없지.
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#034.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#034.dst: 아무튼 가능하면 제독의 집무실로 가 보게. 은행 바로 옆이라 못 찾을 수가 없어.
The Mercenary#034.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#035.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#035.dst: 그럼 난 이만! 찾을 병사가 아직 많거든. 소집에 응한다면 행운을 비네!
The Mercenary#035.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#037.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#037.dst: 으, 맙소사- 바쁜 거 안 보이나? 지금 그럴 시간이...
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#038.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#038.dst: 아. 병사로군. 좋아, 명단에 한 명 추가다. 정찰병은 만났겠지.
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#039.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#039.dst: 기대만큼 많진 않지만, 이걸로 버텨야지. 내려오게, 다른 이들은 이미 브리핑실에 있네.
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#040.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#040.dst: 흥. 모을 수 있는 병사는 이게 다인가 보군. 좋다!
The Mercenary#040.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#041.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#041.dst: 먼저 상황이다. {p}의 Takan 사령관이 자리를 버리고, 현지 도적 무리의 우두머리가 됐다.
The Mercenary#041.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#042.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#042.dst: 그의 지휘 아래 놈들은 한밤중에 우리 병력을 기습했고, 북동쪽 병영을 점령했다.
The Mercenary#042.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#043.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#043.dst: 우리 전 병력이 포로가 되거나 죽었다! 이런 치욕이. {p}에 전령을 보냈고, 지원을 약속받았지만...
The Mercenary#043.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#044.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#044.dst: 난 이 일을 빠르고 조용히 처리하고 싶다. 그래서 너희 다섯이 필요하지.
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#045.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#045.dst: 너희는 병영을 공격해 잠입하고, 반역한 사령관을 암살한다. 여기 처리할 일이 많으니 전략은 너희에게 맡기겠다.
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#046.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#046.dst: 질문 하나 해도 될까요? 사령관이 공격한 이유를 아시나요? 그답지 않은데요.
The Mercenary#046.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#047.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#047.dst: ...아니. 그런 공격을 할 만한 동기는 떠오르지 않는군. 그게 다인가?
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#049.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#049.dst: 그럼 난 가 보겠다! 행운을 빈다, 병사들. 이 재앙이 속히 끝나길 바란다.
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#050.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#050.dst: ...이런. 도적이라니 골치 아프겠네. 어떤 놈들인지 알아?
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#051.dst: 그게 중요해? 어떤 놈들이든 어차피 싸우게 될 텐데.
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#052.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#052.dst: 사실 중요할 수도 있어요... 도적단마다 강한 정도가 다르거든요. 어느 무리인지 미리 알면, 아마-
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#053.dst: 여기서 너무 오래 서 있었어. 자, 병영 가까이 가자. 계획은 거기서 세우면 돼.
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#058.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#058.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#059.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#059.dst: 그게 무슨 문제야! 무리 한가운데 폭탄 던지면 쾅, 문제 해결이지.
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#061.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#061.dst: 그럴 순 없어요. 그러면 거의 확실히 건물이 손상될 거예요!
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#062.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#062.dst: 아, 맞다. 역사적 가치를 잊으면 안 되지. 잘 짚었어.
The Mercenary#062.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#063.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#063.dst: ...그래. 아무튼 도적들을 힘으로 뚫긴 어려울 것 같아. 돌아갈 방법을 찾아야 해...
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#064.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#064.dst: 음, 끼어들어도 된다면- 난 제대로 된 전투엔 별 쓸모가 없을 거야! 다리를 다쳐서. 움직이기가 좀 힘들거든!
The Mercenary#064.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#065.dst: 그러니 정면 돌파가 안 된다면, 내가 주의를 끌어 볼까? 그런 마법이 있고, 밖에서 훨씬 쓸모 있을 거야.
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#066.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#066.dst: 통할 수도 있겠어요... 제가 같이하면, 다른 사람들이 다른 쪽으로 잠입하는 동안 시선을 끌 수 있죠.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#067.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#067.dst: 좋은 생각이야. 그런데 어떻게 들어가지? 앞쪽 말고는 입구가 없는 것 같은데.
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#069.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#069.dst: Linton, 내가 생각하는 쪽으로 가는 얘기는 아니길 바라.
The Mercenary#069.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#070.dst: 그래, 그 얘기 맞아. 근데 들어 봐! 입구가 없잖아? 그럼 직접 만들면... 벽에 구멍을 내서?
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#071.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#071.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#073.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#073.dst: 바로 그거야! 전문가를 좀 더 믿어, Aledar.
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#074.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#075.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#075.dst: 흠. 아니, 난 안 믿을래. 어쨌든 계획은 섰네. 그럼 {u}, Linton, 나는 병영에 침입한다.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#077.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#077.dst: 그동안 Lanu랑 난 놈들 주의를 끌게. 좋은 계획이야! 가자고.
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#079.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#079.dst: 자, 자. 뚫고 들어가기 딱 좋은 곳 같은데, 안 그래, Aledar?
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#080.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#080.dst: 그래, Linton, 괜찮아 보여. {u}, 우린 Takan을 찾자. 우리 둘이면 처치할 수 있을 거야.
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#081.dst: 난 포로가 된 병사들을 찾을게! Amerigo 책상에서 병영 지도를 훔쳤으니 쉽게 찾을 수 있지!
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#082.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#082.dst: 너-... 됐다, 신경 안 쓸래. 제발 네 일이나 해 줄래?
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#084.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#087.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#087.dst: 젠장... 젠장, 젠장, 전부 다 젠장! 잠시도 날 가만두지 않는군, 그 쥐새끼 Amerigo...
The Mercenary#087.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#088.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#088.dst: ...정말 전부 내가 직접 해야 하나?! 이건 마치-
The Mercenary#088.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#089.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#089.dst: 아, 알겠군. 무슨 일인지 알겠어. Amerigo의 개들이 또 일 처리하러 왔나?! 내 눈앞으로 나와라.
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#090.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#090.dst: 신참 같군... 아직 전쟁의 얼굴을 가까이서 직접 볼 만큼 오래 있진 않았지?
The Mercenary#090.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#091.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#091.dst: 이게 옳다고 보나? 참호에서 싸우는 건 우리인데, 그 빌어먹을 제독들이 부와 명예를 다 챙기는 게?!
The Mercenary#091.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#092.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#092.dst: 병사들이 쓰러지고 또 쓰러지고, 다시 일어나는 걸 봤다. 전장의 혼돈과 죽음을 셀 수 없이 겪었지.
The Mercenary#092.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#093.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#093.dst: 그런데 그 멍청이들이 권력을 누릴 자격이 있다고? 권위를?!
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#094.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#094.dst: ...넌 수십 명을 죽였고, 수십 명을 더 가둬 두고 있어.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#095.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#095.dst: 내 말을 증명하려면 그 이상도 할 거다! 놈들이 힘을 쥐었다고?! 진짜 힘을 보여 주마...
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#096.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#096.dst: 너희부터 시작하지. 수십 명에 비하면 둘쯤이야?
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#097.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#097.dst: 물러서라, Shadow Spears. 이 개들은 내가 직접 처리하겠다.
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#098.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#103.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#103.dst: 이 탑은 위로만 갈 수 있어... 어서, 쫓아가야 해! 놓치면 안 돼!
The Mercenary#103.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#104.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.

The Mercenary#107.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#107.dst: 봐, 우리가 진 건 뻔해. 그 멍청이가 도망쳐도 당신네 군인들이 찾아내겠지.
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#108.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#108.dst: 그러니 항복할게! 의미 없는 싸움을 할 이유가 없지. 어차피 이 난장판 뒤엔 돈도 못 받을 테고.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#109.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#109.dst: 자, 탑 열쇠 받아. 성의 표시야. 그놈은 마음대로 해, 난 정말 상관없어.
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#110.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#110.dst: 어차피 난 그놈 형이 더 좋았어. 훨씬 조용했거든.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#111.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#111.dst: 으, 도적이 또... 여긴 내가 막을게.
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#112.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#113.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.

The Mercenary#114.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#114.dst: 으윽... 여긴 왜 올라왔지?! 도망칠 데가 없잖-
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#115.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#116.dst: 아- 안 돼... 이- 이렇게는... 싫어...
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#118.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#118.dst: ...그래서 어떻게든 풀어 줘야 했지! 그래서 버티라고 소리치고는-
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#119.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#119.dst: {u}! 거기 있었구나! 무사히 나와서 다행이야. 도적들이 흩어지는 것 같아.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#120.dst: 내 이야기 흐름도 흩어졌네. 그래서! 그놈 잡았어?
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#121.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#121.dst: 다행이네요. 이 모든 일에서 좋은 일도 하나는 있었군요...
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#122.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#122.dst: 결국 처치해서 다행이야. 그가 한 말들... 위험한 사람 같았어.
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#123.dst: 아, 또 그 얘기야? 아직도 그 생각 중이야?
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#124.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#124.dst: 밖에서 그놈이 외치는 말 몇 개 들었어. 듣기 좋은 말은 아니더라.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#125.src:
Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#125.dst:
Lanu:
역사에 관심 있는 사람도 있다고요, Mel.
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#126.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#126.dst: 난 하나도 못 들었어. 아마 귀가 아직 울려서겠지. 근데 여기 일은 끝난 것 같은데, 그치?
The Mercenary#126.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#127.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#127.dst: 그런 것 같네요. 전 남아서 병사들이 남은 도적을 소탕하는 걸 도울게요.
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#128.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#128.dst: 나도 남을래. 어차피 지금 딱히 할 일도 없거든!
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#129.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#129.dst: 자, 난 간다. 갈 데도 있고! 할 일도 있고! 돌려줄 폭탄도 있거든! 잘 있어!
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#130.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#130.dst: {u}, 그럼 우리 둘이 {p}에 소식을 전하러 가야겠네! 가자.
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#132.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#132.dst: 병사들! 보고하라! 살아남은 게 너희 둘뿐이라곤 하지 마라, 젠장...
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#133.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#133.dst: 아닙니다, 제독님. 임무는 성공했습니다. Takan은 죽었습니다.
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#135.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#135.dst: 그렇군... 만족스러운 성과다, 병사들. 너희 둘과 다른 이들 모두 {p}의 감사를 받을 것이다.
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#136.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#136.dst: 제독님. Takan이 한 말 중에 일부는-
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#137.dst: 반역자의 말은 너무 믿지 마라. 저런 놈들은 근거 없는 독설을 퍼부으며, 우리가 지키는 질서에 맞서 대중을 선동하지.
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#138.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#138.dst: 그는 상상 속 부당함에 원한을 품은 분노한 자일 뿐이다. 그 이상은 없어. 잊어버리는 게 좋을 거다.
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#139.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#139.dst: 오늘 일에 대해선 모두 충분히 보상받을 것이다. 이제 가 봐라. 난 전 사령관 Takan을 처치한 공으로 명예 휘장을 받으러 가야 하니.
The Mercenary#139.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#141.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#141.dst: Takan이 왜 그렇게 그를 싫어했는지 알 것 같아.
The Mercenary#141.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#142.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#142.dst: 다음에 {p}에 가면... Aegis 제독에게 이 얘기를 해 봐야겠어.
The Mercenary#142.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#143.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#143.dst: 아무튼! 대단한 모험이었지? 빨리 Tasim한테 얘기해 주고 싶어.
The Mercenary#143.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#144.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#144.dst: ...그러고 보니. 최근에 그 녀석 소식 들었어? 도무지 연락이 안 돼.
The Mercenary#144.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#145.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#145.dst: 이상해. 마지막으로 들은 건 {p}에 있다는 거였는데, 이젠 거기 없대.
The Mercenary#145.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#146.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#146.dst: 걔가- 뭐? 정말? 나한텐 말도 없이...
The Mercenary#146.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#147.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#147.dst: ...깜빡했나 보지. 괜찮아. 다들 여기서 바쁘잖아, 그치?
The Mercenary#147.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#148.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#148.dst: 그래도 대략적인 위치를 알면 도움이 돼. 편지를 보낼 수 있나 알아볼게. 알려 줘서 고마워.
The Mercenary#148.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#149.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#149.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#150.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#150.dst: 뭐, 괜찮겠지. 언젠가 불쑥 나타날 거야! 기다리기만 하면 돼.
The Mercenary#150.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#151.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#151.dst: 어디로 간 걸까? {p}에서 무슨 임무라도 받았나? 아니면 Gavel로 갔을까...?
The Mercenary#151.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#152.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#152.dst: 뭐, 됐어. 다시 봐서 반가웠어! 비록... 음. 좀 이상하긴 했지만.
The Mercenary#152.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#154.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#154.dst: 자, 난 이만 가 볼게. 또 보자, {u}!
The Mercenary#154.speaker: Aledar
